replayIdentity.EventEnvelope: eventId is event- plus canonical digest excluding eventId and receivedAt
replayIdentity.ExecutionProjection: eventHash covers complete record except eventHash; original stable receivedAt is included and may not change on retry
replayIdentity.PortfolioGenesis: Approved native-only alias of exact source PortfolioSnapshotSchema with parsePortfolioGenesis semantics. Requires paper-simulation sequence1 continuous checkpoint and hashes full snapshot excluding only sourceEventHash and continuity.highWaterEventHash. Ordinary PortfolioSnapshot validation is unchanged.
replayIdentity.NativeFacts: NativeFact, NativeFactProjection and NativeJournalProof are generated from vertex-native-facts.civet. Full projection hash excludes only eventHash. Generic NativeJournalProof validates its own schema/refinements only; approved two-input helper additionally binds original canonical proof bytes <=1MiB and private source-derived crossbinding semantics. Proof journalSequence/head match projection proofJournalSequence/proofJournalHeadHash, and proof factOrdinal matches projection factOrdinal (0..63). Journal sequence is not projection sequence; one transition can emit multiple ordinal facts.
replayIdentity.RuntimePolicySelection: Canonical hash covers every source selection field except selectionSha256; source policy/reference/module/capability/group joins are retained. Selection records, component evidence and ownership pins do not grant current authorization.
replayIdentity.WorkerTransport: Nested projection, model-use, epoch and replay fields retain actual source schema refinements, not stronger standalone parser checks. Services must explicitly invoke standalone native validation where source parse helpers are required. WorkerBytes remains its source structural base64 rule; only CanonicalApprovalBase64 and replay fields receive strict canonical decoding semantics.
replayIdentity.ModelUse: Standalone ModelUseRequest verifies canonical requestSha256; nested WorkerCurrentModelUseInput retains schema-only semantics. Grant/proof source refinements and evidence uniqueness are preserved. ModelUseProof validation does not prove a current grant, aggregate compute reservation, evidence liveness or first-dispatch admission, and does not authorize model/provider dispatch or capital.
replayIdentity.PortfolioEpochTransition: Standalone validation additionally parses the embedded PortfolioGenesis identity. Nested worker transition schema does not silently gain that stronger check. Transition hash includes approvalBase64, while the replay-grant signing subject excludes only approvalBase64.
replayIdentity.NativeOutboxReplay: Standalone validate runs the complete source-backed private replay adapter after schema/refinements: strict canonical base64, bounded original canonical JSON bytes, raw serialization SHA distinct from event identity, fixed PortfolioGenesis/PortfolioSnapshot/ExecutionProjection/NativeFactProjection dispatch, exact old-epoch/scope/emitter/sequence/head joins and paired native journal proof validation. Private NativeReplayRowBinding receives exactly {grant,identity,value,priorHash}; snapshots preserve the prior head. Approval signature, actual journal/fence/outbox evidence and current authenticated grants remain independent external requirements.
replayIdentity.RetainedEpochTransitionV4: Required nullable replay.retainedEpochTransitionBase64 and grant.retainedEpochTransitionSha256 form an explicit null pair on the normal path. A present sidecar requires startingSequence0/null head and first genesis. Standalone replay verifies original canonical sidecar bytes/raw SHA, full PortfolioEpochTransition validation and exact snapshot bytes against the first original projection. Private NativeReplayRetainedTransitionBinding receives exactly {grant,transition} and binds snapshot ownerEpoch to grant.priorOwnerEpoch plus account/stream. Historical prior epoch remains older and current replay owner newer under existing source refinements. The current replay signing subject includes the new sidecar SHA. No expired historical approval becomes current authority: original signature/current key-approval-nonce nonrevocation, fresh explicit human ratification, actual native evidence and exact cloud prior-head CAS remain independent admission responsibilities.
replayIdentity.authorityWarning: Validation and replay identity prove neither publisher authentication nor approved capital. Native journal ownership, fencing, current grants and per-event authorization remain separate. All base drafts and control projections retain nonauthority flags.

limits.replayAggregateIncludes: Current grant approval, complete original retained-transition sidecar when present, every projection and every proof; sidecar bytes counted once inside the existing 8MiB cap
limits.workBudgetAccounting: Finite instructions and ceiling(byteLength/1024) string/decode work units, not one instruction per base64 character; hard byte/node/depth limits remain independent.
limits.scope: Bounded admission/off-hot-path ceilings only; not latency, peak-memory or all-public-maxima acceptance proofs. API/network readers need stricter per-contract ingress limits; never parse maximum-size inputs in tick/callback paths.

portability.regularExpressions: Finite 17-pattern source-bound allowlist, including actual worker/policy regex spellings; unknown regex support unavailable. Unicode scalar values, ASCII digit shorthand, UTF-16 source string lengths, codepoint key ordering.
portability.replayOpcodes: Exactly base64Length, sum, at and index were added. base64Length enforces nonempty canonical RFC4648 decode/re-encode and 1MiB decoded cap; sum uses bounded exact integers; at rejects negative/noninteger/out-of-range indices; index is lexically scoped to every/some/sum and resets across named calls. No domain-shaped replay opcode.
portability.uriBackend: Source-compatible WHATWG parsing authored through exact ada-url==4.0.0 Python binding and existing Rust url==2.5.7. Python authority construction fails ContractUnavailable if backend distribution/version/native load is unavailable; no urllib fallback. Source HTTPS/empty credentials/query/fragment predicates inspect normalized parser components while canonical hashes preserve the original URI string. IDNA/punycode, percent-normalized hosts, legacy IPv4/IPv6, special-scheme recovery and empty query/fragment fixtures authored; cross-runtime parity remains unverified until deferred conformance.
portability.resourceRejection: Budgets fail closed before or during bounded work; unsupported bundle/profile/schema keyword/opcode/rule never falls back to structural-only acceptance.
portability.gammaHashes: Original raw Gamma provenance hashes remain unchanged and separate from newly encoded canonical artifact digests.

Six added v4 orchestration cases cover full retained-transition dispatch, original raw hash/canonical bytes, exact first-snapshot bytes, required null pairing and sidecar aggregate accounting. Synthetic orchestration cases do not replace source-backed conformance.
